hero.name: Mendoza, Luke Reed Chard R.
hero.description: Game Developer | The One That Got Away | YB

about.content: Hello! I am Luke Reed Chard R. Mendoza, 22 years old, I am an aspiring game developer with a passion for creating interactive worlds and memorable player experiences. I am constantly learning new tools, experimenting with ideas, and sharpening my skills so I can build games that are both fun and meaningful.
